agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited consolidated financial statements, granting full discharge of responsibility to the Board of Directors and Commissioners. The audit was conducted by Kanaka Puradiredja, Suhartono.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved allocating the 2025 net profit for cash dividends of Rp950 per share, a Rp1 billion reserve fund, and project development. The total cash dividend is set at Rp900,784,300,000.
Agenda #3: Kanaka Puradiredja, Suhartono was appointed to audit the 2026 fiscal year, with the Board of Directors authorized to set fees. The Board of Commissioners is authorized to appoint a replacement if necessary.
Agenda #4: The meeting approved a 5% honorarium increase for 2026 and a total 2025 bonus of Rp20,619,790,000 to be distributed in 2026.
Agenda #5: The meeting resolved to maintain the current composition of the Board of Commissioners and Directors, consisting of 16 commissioners and 6 directors, with no changes. All members will continue their roles until their terms expire on June 30, 2028.
